question: Can the retained P2AD developer-specific TRI-X contrast-index paths be represented as strict, reversible, hash-versioned process-response profiles without inventing photographic tone or extrapolating beyond the source graph?
forbidden: extrapolate development time or contrast index outside each observed vector path
interpret contrast index as a complete exposure-to-density or display tone curve
infer grain, acutance, MTF, scanner, print, stock comparison or photographic appearance
add these source profiles to the production FilmProfileBundle or change product defaults

branch_rule.pass: retain a research-only typed B&W process-response profile primitive; a future photographic leaf still requires measured characteristic curves and scanner/print interpretation
branch_rule.fail: retain P2AD source evidence only and do not compile a process profile

claim_ceiling: Research-only typed interpolation of first-party TRI-X 400 developer contrast-index paths; not calibrated sensitometry, a photographic tone operator, process emulation or product profile.
